_about: Intent scenarios for the Sierra Leone aggregate run (2026Q1). Expected values worked out by hand from what each indicator should show; rounded as analytics shows them (2 decimals).

scenarios.title: ANC LLITN coverage: 70 LLITNs at 100 ANC 1st visits
scenarios.note: Jan: LLITN fixed 30, outreach 10; ANC1 fixed 40, outreach 10. Feb: LLITN fixed 25, outreach 5; ANC1 fixed 45, outreach 5. After: (30+10+25+5)/100 = 70 %. Before: the fixed term read an old option combo (no data) and LLITN aggregated with COUNT, so the outreach term counted 2 reports: 2/100 = 2 %.

scenarios.title: NVP during labour: 16 of 20 HIV-positive women
scenarios.note: Jan: NVP 15-24y 6, 25-49y 10; HIV-positive 15-24y 8, 25-49y 12. 16/20 = 80 %; before, the Number type showed 0.8.

values.dataElement: PMTCT women received NVP during labour
PMTCT women received NVP during labour

scenarios.title: Penta 1 - measles dropout: same value before and after
scenarios.note: Jan: Penta1 20, measles 15; Feb: Penta1 10, measles 10 (all fixed, <1y). Quarter (30-25)/30 = 16.67 %; Jan 25 %, Feb 0 %. Moving the divisor keeps the value at every level (operands are aggregated before the expression is evaluated, A5); the only change is no value instead of NaN where Penta 1 is 0 (engine check, facility C in February).

scenarios.title: FIC <1y adjusted for reporting: 30 fully immunized, every month reported, population 1200
scenarios.note: FIC (fixed, <1y) Jan 12, Feb 6, Mar 12 = 30; Child Health reported every month (rate 100 %); population <1y 1200. 30/1200 x 100, annualized x 365/90 = 10.14. Before, the old #{dataSet.REPORTING_RATE} form made the numerator 0.

scenarios.title: IPT 2nd dose by TBAs: 60 doses in the quarter
scenarios.note: IPT 2nd dose by TBA (fixed) Jan 10, Feb 20, Mar 30; ANC 2nd visit (fixed) 50 each month. After: 60 doses, 60/150 = 40 %. Before, AVERAGE gave the mean month (20): 20 doses, 13.33 %.
